messages:
Maria: FYI partner just flagged a hold on PO 789012 — AP rejected the invoice because vendor verification failed (foreign entity + currency). This is the Dedicated HW deal closing Friday, need workaround.
AP-bot: Invoice 2024-678 rejected: missing tax form (W-8/W-9) and vendor bank validation. Status: PAYMENT_HOLD.
Dan: Can you share vendor legal name, VAT/EIN, and bank details? AP needs those or a marketplace onboarding to process EUR.
Katie: Partner says vendor is a UK LLP (legal: "BrightEdge Hardware LLP"). They provided a VAT registration cert but cannot provide a US W-9. Their payment bank is GBP/EUR denominated. Portal alias = "redwood-hw-dist".
Lee: If vendor is non-US, W-8BEN-E is expected. Two paths: 1) vendor registers in marketplace (so Redwood MO is merchant-of-record) and invoice flows through portal; or 2) vendor provides W-8 + VAT docs and AP accepts EUR payment. We can also add a small PO addendum to accept EUR invoices and specify tax docs required.
Maria: PO excerpt:
```
PO: 789012
Amount: EUR 198,500
Vendor_alias: redwood-hw-dist
Vendor_legal: BrightEdge Hardware LLP
Payment_terms: NET 30 (GBP/EUR bank)
```
Dan: Accounting can't pay an invoice that arrives under an alias not mapped in vendor master. Either vendor completes marketplace onboarding or we need a signed vendor form + copy of bank details and VAT cert. EDI mapping needs vendor TAX_ID field populated.
Katie: Onboarding timeline is ~5 business days and partner is pushing to close before that. They asked if we can accept the invoice if we do a manual alias mapping for this one deal.
Lee: Legal can approve a one-off waiver if partner signs an indemnity addendum that states Redwood is not liable for upstream tax withholdings and confirms vendor tax status. I can draft a one-paragraph addendum.
Arnab: Deal closes Friday — any delay kills the quarter. Sales ok with indemnity addendum if legal keeps it lean. No long procurement loops.
Maria: Action items: Katie to get scanned VAT cert + W-8BEN-E OR request partner reissue via marketplace; Lee to draft one-paragraph indemnity; Dan to prep AP guidance for manual alias mapping if needed. Deadline COB tomorrow. Jira: SUPPORT-3421 (partner-onboard).
AP-bot: Vendor alias redwood-hw-dist not found in vendor master. Manual mapping request created: AP-TICKET-8891.
Dan: If partner can email invoice to marketplace-invoices@redwood.com with vendor VAT + bank details cc: finance, AP can process as exception while portal registration completes.
Katie: I'll ask partner to re-issue to marketplace email and send VAT + W-8 scan. Looping in partner contact Oliver. @Oliver can you confirm partner can reissue by EOD tomorrow?
Oliver: Yes — I pinged them, they'll reissue to the marketplace address and attach VAT + W-8BEN-E. ETA tomorrow morning.
Maria: Great. Lee — please post the short addendum text here so sales can get signatures.
Lee: Draft: "Vendor agrees that Redwood may accept invoices issued under its portal alias; Vendor warrants the accuracy of tax registration and indemnifies Redwood for any taxes, penalties, or withholdings arising from non-compliance." Keep it 2 lines.
Arnab: Fine to sign. Please send to partner legal and ask for quick sign.
Maria: Thanks everyone — assigning: Katie (collect docs + confirm invoice reissue), Lee (send addendum), Dan (prep AP exception flow). Will update SUPPORT-3421. If docs don't land by EOD tomorrow escalate to CRO. :thumbsup:
Dan: Noted.
Katie: On it.
AP-bot: AP-TICKET-8891 status: waiting-on-vendor-docs.
Maria: Closing loop for now — will post final when invoice accepted.
Arnab: :rocket:
